title: Unauthorized USB and Malware Activity
description: An unauthorized USB storage device is connected to a workstation, followed by suspicious PowerShell execution and outbound network activity.

expected_classification.impact: Potential endpoint compromise and malware execution

injects.title: Unauthorized removable media detected
injects.content: Unknown USB storage device connected to KALRO-PC-07. Device authorization status is unknown.

injects.title: Suspicious PowerShell execution
injects.content: powershell.exe executed with suspicious command-line behaviour shortly after USB insertion.

injects.title: Outbound connection observed
injects.content: KALRO-PC-07 initiates HTTPS communication to an unknown external address with suspicious reputation.

injects.title: Containment verification
injects.content: After isolation, no further suspicious outbound connections are observed.

title: Phishing and Compromised User Account
description: A KALRO user reports a phishing email, followed by repeated failed sign-ins, a successful login from an unfamiliar source, and suspicious mailbox changes.

expected_classification.impact: Potential unauthorized mailbox and account access

injects.title: Suspicious login
injects.content: Authentication monitoring flags 14 failed sign-ins followed by a successful login to carol@kalro.org from 203.0.113.24 using an unrecognized Windows / Chrome browser.

injects.title: Phishing report
injects.content: Carol Njoroge reports receiving an email titled “Action Required: Verify Your KALRO Mailbox” from security-update@kalro-helpdesk.example. The message linked to https://kalro-verify.example/login.

injects.title: Mailbox persistence
injects.content: A new mailbox forwarding rule is detected on carol@kalro.org and the unfamiliar session remains active.

injects.title: Recovery evidence
injects.content: After session revocation, credential reset, MFA verification and removal of the forwarding rule, no further suspicious logins are observed.

phishing_email.subject: Action Required: Verify Your KALRO Mailbox
phishing_email.body_preview: Your mailbox will be temporarily restricted unless you verify your account before the end of the day. Use the verification link below to confirm your KALRO account.
phishing_email.indicator_note: The display name imitates KALRO ICT, but the sender domain and verification URL are not kalro.org.

alert.title: Suspicious sign-in after reported phishing email
observations: 14 failed sign-in attempts were recorded before a successful login.
The successful login originated from an unfamiliar external IP address and unrecognized browser.
The user reported a suspicious account-verification email shortly before the login.
A new mailbox forwarding rule and active unfamiliar session indicate possible persistence.

incident_defaults.title: Phishing and Compromised KALRO User Account
incident_defaults.description: Carol Njoroge (carol@kalro.org) reported a suspicious account-verification email. Authentication monitoring subsequently recorded repeated failed sign-in attempts followed by a successful login from an unfamiliar external IP and unrecognized browser. The event is being treated as a possible phishing-induced credential compromise.
incident_defaults.email_subject: Action Required: Verify Your KALRO Mailbox

title: Ransomware-Like Endpoint Activity
description: An endpoint begins rapidly renaming files and generating ransom-note artefacts while attempting network access to shared resources.

expected_classification.impact: Potential data encryption and lateral spread

injects.title: Mass file changes
injects.content: Rapid file rename and extension changes detected on KALRO-PC-21.

injects.title: Ransom note created
injects.content: A ransom-note file appears on the desktop and multiple directories become inaccessible.

injects.title: Shared-drive connection attempt
injects.content: The endpoint attempts SMB connections to shared resources.

injects.title: Restoration readiness
injects.content: Endpoint is isolated and a clean restore point is available.

title: Suspected Insider Data Exfiltration
description: A privileged user accesses an unusually large volume of sensitive files and transfers data to an unapproved destination.

expected_classification.impact: Potential unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information

injects.title: Unusual bulk access
injects.content: A privileged account reads a large number of sensitive files outside normal working patterns.

injects.title: Unapproved transfer
injects.content: A large outbound transfer is detected to an unapproved destination.

injects.title: Continued access
injects.content: The account continues accessing sensitive repositories after the alert.

title: Brute-Force and Suspicious Authentication
description: Repeated failed authentication attempts are followed by a successful login from a new source.

injects.title: Failed-login burst
injects.content: More than 50 failed logins target one account in a short period.

injects.title: Successful login
injects.content: A successful login occurs from the same unfamiliar source after the failed attempts.

injects.title: Post-login activity
injects.content: The account attempts access to resources not normally used by the user.
expected_actions: Escalate if privilege abuse is suspected
